brief: A three-storey cabinet with at least three drawers.

requirements.evidence: Column at 0,0 has bases on levels 0, 1 and 2 (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:0,0,1;full, piece:0,0,2;full with snaps between levels), plus supporting column at 1,0 on same three levels to create cabinet volume. Three vertical levels = three storeys.

Three notch drawer frames installed in the interstitial position 0,1: notch:0#0,1#notch1 (level 0), notch:1#0,1#notch1 (level 1), notch:2#0,1#notch1 (level 2) – one drawer per storey, all hex-drawer-frame-notch-fm.

finish.summary: Built a 2-column x 3-level cabinet (6 full bases) providing three storeys, with three notch drawer frames stacked vertically at 0,1 on levels 0-2. check_build passes meshClash: clear.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
